notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms row and a county index heading were found. The name 'ben hill' matches the county name, and the tnlandforms note says that for towers 73 and above 'names are my creation', so the label may be the list author's rather than an official name; the note's numbering is ambiguous. No history, staffing, fire or site description was found, and the status and access in the record are unverified. Suggest Ben Hill County and Fitzgerald local history sources, Georgia Forestry Commission history staff, and the Digital Library of Georgia for period photographs.
